title: Each type as a bus/rickshaw passenger
caption:
Every rickshaw and bus ride, as experienced by the 16 types.

One has had exact change ready since leaving home. One is reading the poetry painted on the back of the rickshaw. One co-founded a business with the driver in ten minutes. One found the engine fault before the next signal.

Tag your daily commute buddy.

Which passenger are you?
